by: diaries-2 session (Opus), ruling 96; to be appended by the integrator at the merge
title: One record of the query-nz ingest MCP's parliament-diaries corpus (one meeting of a minister's monthly diary release), as support/mcpsource lands it (JSON, keys sorted, no spaces, without seq)

landmarks: a JSON object with `id` (text) equal to `rowid` (integer)
`minister`, `portfolio`, `date` (YYYY-MM-DD), `year`, `time`, `meeting`, `location`, `attendees`: text as the provider read them from the release PDF
`source_url`: the PDF's address under https://www.beehive.govt.nz/sites/default/files/, or its file name only
`capture` {_collected, source_url}, `_collected`, `updated_at`, and `text` (the provider's join of the fields)

signals_note: Landed by support/mcpsource from the MCP's records tool; the document's name `parliament-diaries/<id>` and its arrival row in mcpsource.arrivals say which corpus it is. Nothing is fetched from beehive.govt.nz (ruling 78).
notes: No model reads it: the fields are taken as served (ruling 79 untouched). Withholdings kept as printed; a location shown only as a place of business; `text` private. A field this profile does not name is listed in entries.fields_unread and support/mcpsource's drift table.
